contribution: Developing empirical methods for estimating demand and supply in differentiated-product markets, which transformed empirical industrial organization, merger analysis and competition policy
rationale: This is a judgment-based guess, not something I know. Recent prizes went to economic history and institutions (2023–2024) and to innovation-driven growth (2025), so the committee may turn to applied microeconomics. Empirical industrial organization has long been overdue for recognition. The BLP framework (Berry–Levinsohn–Pakes, 1995) and Olley–Pakes production-function estimation are foundational and widely used in research and antitrust practice. Strong alternatives include New Keynesian monetary theory (Woodford, Galí, Blanchard) and empirical public finance (Saez and others).
